howto.what: Claude 会按该技能中的 esm SDK 用法,给你蛋白序列生成、结构预测、逆折叠、嵌入提取等任务的 Python 示例代码,并说明模型选择与 API 认证。

say.text: 用 ESM3 根据这段部分序列生成完整蛋白,给我 Python 代码。

say.text: 怎么从一个 PDB 结构文件反推氨基酸序列?
用 ESM C 给这几条蛋白序列算嵌入。

howto.what_en: Claude will provide Python code examples and guidance from the ESM skill for protein sequence generation, structure prediction, inverse folding, embeddings, and ESMFold2 workflows, including model selection and API authentication.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the conversation involves the esm Python SDK, ESM3/ESMC model IDs, Forge/Biohub inference clients, or ESMFold2 folding workflows.

say_en.text: Use ESM3 to fill in this partial protein sequence and show Python code.
How do I design a sequence that folds into this PDB structure?
Use ESM C to get embeddings for these protein sequences.
